name: Moonflower~Spirit of Santana

evidence.note: Oct 3, 8 PM at The Showplace, Bellmore: billed as a concert experience with Latin percussion and guitarist Nick Sassano.
Press kit: playing the NY metro area since 2021; says the show keeps audiences on their feet.
News story on an outdoor park concert in Syosset.

dancing.notes: A concert-style tribute in a small theater. The band says it keeps audiences on their feet, and Santana's Latin rhythms invite some dancing, but it is mainly a show.

description: A New York-area Santana tribute band led by guitarist Nick Sassano, with Latin percussion and Santana's guitar-driven Latin rock hits.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Other Santana tributes named Moonflower exist (Tampa, FL and Las Vegas). This is the NY metro band led by Nick Sassano, as named on the Bellmore listing. No salsa evidence.
